question: What is the publisher of 'Bericht zur Datenqualität der GLES 2009'?
What is the publication date of 'Selbsteinschätzung der Religiosität bei türkischstämmigen Einwanderern'?
What is the number of authors for 'Converging on euroscepticism : online polity contestation during European Parliament elections'?
Who has the highest publication count?
sparql: SELECT ?authorName WHERE { ?publication <https://schema.org/author> ?author . ?author <https://schema.org/name> ?authorName . } GROUP BY ?author ?authorName ORDER BY DESC(COUNT(?publication)) LIMIT 1
